title: System Selection
description: Choosing which system to activate for a tactical action: highlighted targets on the map, an inspector with a confirm bar, and map overlays that help the decision.

shots.heading: The prompt
shots.caption: Every system the player may activate is outlined and marked TARGET. Systems that already hold the player's command token are dimmed and marked ACTIVATED. The bar at the bottom says what is being decided.

shots.heading: A system is selected
shots.caption: Clicking a hex opens the inspector (here Lodor #26: wormhole, planets, units present) and a confirm bar. Nothing is activated until Confirm Activation.

shots.heading: Resources and influence overlay
shots.caption: The resource/influence overlay replaces the unit tokens with each system's resources (gold) and influence (blue), so economy-driven choices can be made from the map alone.

shots.heading: Space combat overlay
shots.caption: The Space Combat overlay highlights where fleets would meet, to check what an activation runs into before confirming.

notes.title: Overlays
notes.text: Standard, Economy (resource and influence icons), Space Combat, Ground Combat and Tech Skips can be switched at any time while choosing.

notes.title: Fixture
notes.text: The board is the synthetic gallery board used by the dev decision gallery, not a captured game.
